high_level_description: This image captures an urban landscape featuring a modern architectural complex with a unique design. The buildings are multi-storied and exhibit a mix of materials, including brickwork and glass. The most striking feature is the building on the left, which has a curved, wave-like roof covered in red bricks, giving it a distinctive and artistic appearance. This building also has scaffolding around its lower sections, suggesting ongoing construction or maintenance. The surrounding buildings are more traditional in style, with rectangular shapes and a combination of brick and glass facades.
